technical-summary: The Flash-Next launcher passed handoff.histogram_period_s=60 by default while the derived live placement policy judges heat younger than ~10 s and evaluates every ~5 s; a default start carried the policy but its feed was stale (26 no_live_feed lines, 6 evaluations, 0 moves in ~15 min). The default is now 1 s, the period every calibration and A/B used; it is not part of the plan or calibration key.
user-summary-candidate: The live expert placement now actually receives fresh usage data on a normal start instead of sitting idle.
